services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Conveniently located in the heart of downtown Barrie, the MacLaren offers a variety of spaces for your next corporate event, whether it’s a conference, lecture, meeting or workshop. Our hospitality staff are on hand to provide the coffee break, reception, lunch or dinner that best suits your needs. Audiovisual equipment and free public Wi-Fi are available for easy communication between participants. We can accommodate up to 200 people and our building is wheelchair accessible with ample parking. The MacLaren is available to host your company’s holiday party.
